Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 8: the slip of [[Han Solo (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“[Pilot] 3. Cards with "Han" in title are destiny +3. May use 1 Force to cancel Boba Fett's or Jabba's game text for remainder of turn. If opponent just initiated battle here, may use 1 Force to take the first weapons segment action.”), word for word the text of [[Han Solo (V) (Virtual Block 1)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
